OVERHEAR.Definition: hear by chance, without being part of the conversation

CATEGORISING.Definition: putting into groups according to type

CLICHES.Definition: phrases used so often that they are no longer original or interesting

EUPHEMISMS.Definition: mild or polite words used instead of more direct, unpleasant ones

PROVERBS.Definition: short, well-known sayings that give advice or state a general truth

OVERLAP.Definition: an area that two or more things share

AT HAND.Definition: that we are dealing with now

ROUNDABOUT.Definition: indirect; not going straight to the point

SUBCONSCIOUSLY.Definition: without the speaker being aware of it

WOULDN’T THINK TWICE.Definition: would not stop to think carefully

HARD AND FAST.Definition: fixed and definite, with no exceptions

DIALECTS.Definition: forms of a language spoken in particular areas or by particular groups

MORAL.Definition: the useful lesson to be learnt

TIP.Definition: a small piece of useful advice

OVEREMPHASISED.Definition: given more importance than it deserves
